inputs.prompt: A locked-off wide shot of a sunlit bedroom in the morning. The camera is fixed and never moves. A man sits up in bed holding his phone and reads it; he barely moves. A faint double of him, made of soft mint light, stands beside the desk and gives him a small, warm smile. Then the double flows into a ribbon of soft mint light that streams across the room and into the phone in the man's hands, and is gone; the phone's screen glows softly. Smooth, gentle, elegant motion, like a premium advertising film. Nothing spooky, no mist, no smoke, no text.

expect.basis: wp2-5's Kling 4.0 shots at 1080p cost $0.235 a second (demo-video/ledger/wp2-5.csv)

note: Phase C (A, V20): the return: he smiles, then flows back into the phone in Ram's hand (route K, key frames r0, a-phone-3-back, r2)
